description: Vietnamese Railway Crossing IoT Sensor Data is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Anh Tuan Ngo (FPT University). This dataset contains operational records collected from railway level crossings in Vietnam, including data from sensors, meters, and signal systems. Each record is uniquely identified by a UUID and timestamped to capture the exact sequence of events within a train passage session. Coverage: national (VN); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
